[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
'''Margaret Glasgow''' was born in 1646.<ref name="Baptism1646">"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-8QZ : 16 September 2021), Margreat Glasgou, 1646.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
An Old Parish Register index records Margaret Glasgow and William Thomsone at Kirknewton and East Calder on 2 September 1674.<ref name="Marriage1674">Scotland's People, ''Old Parish Registers: banns and marriages'', index entry for Margaret Glasgow and William Thomsone, 2 September 1674, Kirknewton and East Calder, parish 690, reference 10/73, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland’s People] (original image not inspected; supplied index, reviewed 10 September 2026).</ref> The entry is compatible with this profile by name, district and age, but it supplies no parent or residence. It is a combined banns/marriages index, so the original register must be checked before treating the date as a proved wedding date or adding a structured spouse.

A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margrat Glasgow and John Aiton on 18 October 1693 at Cambusnethan.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 628/10 / 344; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margaret Glasgow and John Tailzer on 18 December 1690 at Walston.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 658/10 / 206; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
